Other exchange students
We kindly ask you to go through the following steps.
1. Online NOMINATION FORM
Make sure that your coordinator has successfully submitted your nomination. Without the official nomination from your sending institution, we will not be able to continue your application process.
2. Online APPLICATION FORM – student account in the Portal system

C - ATTACHMENTS
Please note that you will be asked to provide us with the following attachments within the deadlines below:
1 – Certificate of English language competence
Upload the certificate issued by the University language department of your home institution or any other international certificate as attachment of your Portal account.
At least
B2
English Proficiency Level is required.
Use
„English certificate“
for title of the uploaded file!!!
2 – Passport photo
Upload your photo – it will be used for the student ID card
Use
„Photo“
for the title of the uploaded file!!!
Ideal photo: colorful face photo in the passport format
If you don´t upload your photo to your account, we won´t be able to make your student ID card, which is necessary to access university buildings, get online on campus, access the canteen, etc.

In case your faculty has set up its own supplementary requirements within the application procedure (for ex., Skype meeting, supplementary language examination, etc), you will be informed about it by the faculty coordinator.
Before your arrival, we will send you another information email indicating more details about the Orientation week, ESN Pardubice (Buddy system), leisure time activities, etc.
VISA APPLICATION PROCEDURE (more info
here
)
If you are required to apply for a visa to enter the Czech Republic, we recommend that you obtain information on the specific requirements directly from the Czech Embassy/Consulate in your home country. Please note that the visa procedure takes 60 days, so make sure you arrange your appointment at the Embassy on time, otherwise you will not manage to start the semester on time, or your visa will be declined!
After submitting your application as well as all required documents, our International Office will send you the required documents for your visa application:
Confirmation of Acceptance (Potvrzení o přijetí ke studiu – in Czech) - issued by the International Office
Accommodation Agreement (Smlouva o smlouvě budoucí – in Czech; English version just for information is
here
) - issued by the Dormitory office
to be able to issue this document, we need you to pay the deposit for accommodation at the dormitories as soon as possible,
you will get all the necessary information concerning the bank account data by email from the dormitory officer,
for further enquiries regarding accommodation, do not hesitate to contact
iskam@upce.cz
The above-mentioned documents will be sent to the International Office of your home university by regular post, that is why it is important to give the correct information about the postal address of your uni. You can also order express delivery service to pick up the letter from our office. This service will be at your expense.
As the official visa procedure takes 60 days, we recommend that you upload all required documents to your Portal account as soon as possible to ensure you receive the visa documents on time. You are also asked to arrange your appointment at the Embassy as soon as possible (June is recommended for the winter semester; November for the summer semester).
You can get more information about the visa application procedure at the Czech Embassy or consulate in your home country, or consult the website of
the Ministry of the Interior
.
ACCOMMODATION AND CATERING
After getting your LA approved by the faculty coordinator, you will receive an automatic email with all the necessary information regarding your accommodation booking in the University dormitories. More information concerning accommodation can be found on the website of the University
Accommodation and Catering Service
.
